_comment: Two tiers. Single-model roles map to a Codex slug + effort, since only OpenAI models are selectable natively. Panel roles need INDEPENDENT priors, which one vendor cannot give: those spawn CLI subprocesses instead, one per arm. Both CLIs authenticate from a subscription; neither needs an API key.
_note_bin: NOT bare `codex` — PATH resolves to a stale brew 0.45.0 with no subagent support.
_diversity_note: claude-opus is the only genuinely independent prior available. Keep it in every panel. codex-terra and codex-55 are different training runs from codex-sol, so they add weak diversity; effort level alone adds almost none. A panel of Codex-only arms is close to one opinion repeated.
_note_roles: code-exact matches upstream's gpt-5.6-sol-max exactly. It is now identical to judgment: on a single vendor the strongest-judgment vs strongest-instruction-following split has nowhere to go, since upstream expressed it by crossing vendors. Kept as separate roles so the distinction returns for free if a Claude delegate path is added.
